causes.cause: The published central is a weighted average of the DCF with three non-DCF lenses at typed, never-tested weights (PHDC 0.45/0.15/0.20/0.20; AMOC 0.45/0.20/0.20/0.15; ARCC 0.50/0.20/0.22/0.08), two of which are structural floors in a 15-25% inflation currency — normalised earnings capitalised at the NOMINAL Ke (27-37%) with zero nominal growth (E/Ke), and historical-cost book after a ~3x devaluation at a justified P/B of 0.07-1.28x against 1.7-4.8x paid — plus own-multiple lenses typed ('6-14x') or circular (AMOC at 0% rerating = price minus bridge); PHDC additionally lacks the class lens (no RNAV anywhere in engine/phdc_study/).
causes.layer: VALUATION — lens synthesis (§1.5 'four lenses, one field'); the PROMOTION RULE violated by the central itself
causes.mechanism: E/Ke at nominal Ke and g=0 is a perpetuity whose real cash flow shrinks at the inflation rate (a run-off): the Fisher-consistent no-real-growth EPV is E/(Ke-pi), larger by Ke/(Ke-pi) = 1.68-2.20x at pi=15% (PHDC implied P/E 3.2x vs 12.25x paid). Book at historical cost is below replacement value after EGP/USD ~30->49. The identical design lands +14.5% ABOVE price on the ADNOCLS reference (Ke 9.43%, pi 2%, wedge 1.27x) and below price on every Egyptian name where Ke-pi is 12-22pp; the constructions were transplanted with no inflation adaptation. The DCF lens itself sits at +7.4%/-2.4%/-2.2% of price on AMOC/ARCC/PHDC; the blend manufactures the discount. The lens construction also amplifies any Ke error (a 5pp Ke cut moves E/Ke +19% but E/(Ke-pi) +45% on PHDC). No script scores a lens value, weight or central against anything (Fundamental_Walkforward_Prompt.md pre-registers drivers only).

causes.cause: No single house macro path exists (five year-1 inflation rates for one fiscal year — PHDC 25.2% trailing, AMOC 14.5%, ARCC 11.5%, EGCH 10%, TMGH none — three terminal inflations, three sovereign quotes), so terminal growth and terminal reinvestment are incoherent with the inflation inside the terminal rate: (a) nominal g below the rate's embedded inflation (PHDC 12% vs 13.6-15.6%; EGCH 5% vs 7%) = an unstated perpetual real decline, or above it once the rate is normalised (TMGH 15%); (b) ARCC charges terminal reinvestment rr = g_nominal/ROIC on REPLACEMENT-COST capital (rr 49.2%, ROIC 10.16% < WACC_T 16.46%) while maintenance capex is already inflation-indexed, so inflation-only growth is charged twice and the study's own grid says 'growth destroys value'; lessons L-048 (six recurrences) and L-055 (five) are registered and bind nothing.
causes.layer: STATEMENT <-> VALUATION interface — macro path, terminal growth, terminal reinvestment (Koller value-driver: g and RONIC on one basis; L-048/L-055)
causes.mechanism: Ke = r_real + pi implies the going-concern nominal growth floor is pi; any g < pi is a real decline that must be stated and sourced. Indexing capex to replacement cost already reinvests the inflation uplift of the capital base; g_nominal/ROIC_replacement charges it again, halving ARCC's terminal multiplier ((1-rr)/(w-g) 4.43x vs 8.73x at rr=0). EGCH reinvests 27.8% of NOPAT (0.05/0.18 on a 'Constructed' ROC) for zero real growth. The incoherence cuts both ways inside one model (PHDC's trailing 25.2% CPI escalation is the optimistic leg; its g=12% against a 26.25% rate the pessimistic one), which is why PHDC's DCF is two errors partly cancelling; net across the book it is pessimistic because rates are frozen at crisis and cash flows are not. This is C1's other half — a nominal rate and a nominal growth are one Fisher pair.

causes.cause: The LEVEL and construction of the cost of equity: a stripped local yield (23.00% - 6.37% Caa1 spread) plus beta x 13.94% total ERP charges Egypt's default risk 1.52 x beta times net (1.4x AMOC/ARCC, 1.6x PHDC/EGCH, 2.2x TMGH) — every name with beta > 0.66 pays the country premium more than once and no lambda scaling exists; the rating basis (6.37%/13.94%) is adopted on the three names furthest below price while the two nearest use the CDS basis (3.41%/9.41%), with no rule, against the protocol's own line 327 'CDS PRIMARY'. Resulting nominal Ke 27.45-37.15% (real 10.8-19.3% at 15% inflation) exceeds every rolling 10-year EGX30 return ever realised, and nothing in the pipeline tests the level of Ke against anything.
causes.layer: VALUATION — cost of capital: level and basis (distinct from C1's path)
causes.mechanism: rf* normalisation is correct (country risk enters once, net), but which spread to strip and which ERP to add back is worth 1.2-3.7pp of Ke and is chosen per study. The 1.52 multiplier is the EM average relative vol while the same Damodaran file gives Egypt 2.66; for local-currency money the 23% bond IS the country risk and the construction charges it again scaled by beta. The market prices TMGH at rf* + beta x 4.58% (mature ERP, zero CRP; implied Ke 23.4%), the other extreme. But the DCF-implied rates on AMOC (>30%), ARCC (25.1-25.9%) and PHDC (26.05-30.9%) cluster at or near the house level, so the level is SECOND-ORDER and confounded with the term structure (C1): a uniform CRP removal overshoots PHDC to +24%, AMOC ~+17% while bringing TMGH only to +4%, and the defensible level cut is a few points plus a term structure, not 8-14pp. The terminal ERP held at 13.94% for ever is the largest single component of C1's move and belongs to this layer.

causes.cause: The [R-FCAL-01] statement calibration is a measurement instrument with no actuator and the wrong target: it scores per-driver log errors against later statements and never scores a lens, blend, discount rate, terminal, bridge or fair value against a later price, so it is blind by construction to C1-C4/C6; its pre-registered correction rules (half strength, sign-stable across eras, cross-book consistency, two-sigma break reset on 5-13 origins) converted every robust bias it found into a watch flag — one number changed in ~170 scored cells (ARCC manufacturing depreciation x1.0298); TMGH's four 'adopted' corrections carry 0.000 log into the forward path and its committed corrections_log.json is EMPTY while the delivered study claims four; the method under-forecasts revenue on four of five names and loses to 'freeze last year's profit' at h1 on four of five, and the studies then build BELOW its centrals.
causes.layer: FUNDAMENTAL CALIBRATION [R-FCAL-01] — target quantity and correction bar (the second half of the calibration)
causes.mechanism: A calibration is a loss function plus a rule for acting on it. The loss is on drivers, not value, and forward_ranges.json enters the studies only as display bands for years 3-5; the action rule is so restrictive on effective n ≈ origins (overlapping horizons, nominal bootstrap CIs, era splits degenerate on AMOC) that measured sign-stable under-forecasts produced nothing, while the half-strength constant is a stated-not-derived free parameter of the species the PROMOTION RULE forbids elsewhere. The one measured over-forecast (PHDC net profit +1.116) is a recognition-clock specification error (L-001) and was correctly fixed as a specification — yet the digest cites 'the walk-forward's own finding that this house leans optimistic' as the counterweight to the one-sided gap gate. Bookkeeping is broken: corrections.py reads a key commit 8fb64664 moved under 'detail' and `continue`s — the [R-ENF-04] empty-result-as-clean failure inside the calibration itself.

causes.cause: A directional selection lean in how contested judgements are resolved: wherever two defensible constructions exist ('publish both'), the study adopted the lower one as the central — ERP basis (rating on the three far-below names), flat vs glide, minority basis (whichever deducts more), nominal vs real fade, PHDC land notes and investments, ARCC tier-2 vs own beta, haircut vs audited normalised EBITDA, replacement-cost lens at 8% weight, terminal reinvestment on nominal g, AMOC provisions at face and circular relative lens — roughly 18 of 22 choices worth >5% of value resolved pessimistic (p ≈ 0.002 under a symmetric coin); and the rule set was adopted from an audit (CLHO) where every defect biased UPWARD, so every procedural instinct and the one-sided [R-GAP-01] gate point down while its stated counterweight is false.
causes.layer: PROCESS — how judgement calls are resolved (cuts across C1-C6)
causes.mechanism: Standing_Research_Protocol.md:27 'every one of which biased the valuation in the same direction: upward ... the rules below exist to remove it' — rf normalisation, marginal Kd above sovereign, guidance never consumed, margins as outputs, the one-sided gap gate all lean down, and 'both framings published' has in practice meant 'the lower framing adopted'. Outside challenges to pessimistic constructions were rejected with 'receipts' (AMOC net-cash double charge survived two editions after a correct reviewer flag, GR7); nine of the ten largest AMOC findings came from outside; every valuation-layer correction that moved a number was triggered by a human question. The digest's justification for one-sidedness — 'the walk-forward finds this house optimistic' — rests on PHDC alone and is contradicted by scores.json on four of five names.
causes.evidence: Per-name choice sets: TMGH 4 low/1 high (hospitality/other real growth the high one), PHDC 5 low/1 high (trailing 25.2% CPI the high one), AMOC 4 low/1 high (CDS basis), ARCC 5 low/1 high (CDS basis). Reader tally over nine files: 65 valuation-affecting defects, 40 DOWN / 25 UP; 17 R-GAP-01 findings, 11 valuation-layer, all found after the human asked. engine/PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS_01-09-2026.md [R-GAP-01] 'ONE-SIDED ON PURPOSE ... the counterweights are ... the fundamental walk-forward's own finding that this house leans optimistic'; engine/amoc_study/CRITIQUE_RESPONSE_06-08-2026.md GR7 'ACCEPT the economics, REJECT the double-count charge — receipt' vs GAP_REVIEW_01-09-2026.md (31.19% retired); CRITIQUE_REGISTER_08-08-2026.md §E.1 'Nine of the ten largest priced findings came from outside'; TMGH GAP_REVIEW:136 declining to treat 35.79% vs a 23.09% price-implied rate as a defect; ARCC efg_bridge.json zero of eight steps 'Testahil off' while the gap review found four house defects a month later. Basis adoption per C4 evidence.
causes.share_of_pessimism: Not separable from C1-C6 — it is the mechanism by which each was resolved downward; largest single instance TMGH minority framing (+34% capacity / +52.8% median). Joint: on TMGH the four low choices (basis +12.5%, glide +33-95%, minority +34%, fade +44%) compound from 53.05 to well above 97.80; on PHDC five low choices compound 10.94 -> 15.7-19. The direction is systematic (p ≈ 0.002), which is what 'ridiculously pessimistic' is measuring.
causes.falsifier: Re-adjudicate the same ~22 contested choices under a stated house rule for each (one ERP basis, one term structure, one minority basis, real-terms parameters, audited bases) and recount: if the adopted framing was the lower-value one in fewer than half the cases — or if the count under the stated rules is still >=15 of 22 low — the lean is in the rules, not their application, and C8 collapses into C1-C6. Or a repository record of an over-optimistic EG study audited and revised down by a gate rather than a reader.

causes.cause: Structural: no gate in the repository examines the valuation layer's OUTPUT or any of its constructions — the r2 sliding schedule, terminal coherence (L-048/L-055), ERP basis, minority basis, bridge, lens weights and lens specification, the Kd-integrity three-assert gate ('All three raise. The build fails') — all exist only as prose; the lessons register binds nothing by design; every mechanical gate (Step 0.0, SIGCM, beta provenance, ground-up, workbook structure, 5,775-cell recalculation, scrub, table discipline) checks process and passed AMOC at -39% with six 'model was wrong' defects behind it; the only output check ([R-GAP-01]) is one-sided, created after a human question, and its DISCOUNT RATE / TERMINAL headings ask about mechanics not level; gap-review corrections already computed then ship unapplied; and the only value-vs-price test (value_gap_backtest) is a one-date cross-section at n=32.
causes.layer: PROCESS / ENFORCEMENT — why the pessimism persists across editions rather than why it exists
causes.mechanism: The same defect species recurred despite registration (macro incoherence six times across four names; terminal real decline five times; unopened filings three times; minority basis three times). A method whose only grade is against the company's statements will never see an error that lives in the rate, the terminal, the lens or the bridge — and those are where the money is. Detection therefore runs through humans, and a gate premised on a false claim about the walk-forward supplies no counterweight.

causes.layer: VALUATION — cost of capital: inputs and weights (symptom of the absent Cost_of_Capital_Reference.md)
causes.mechanism: Every Ke moves one-for-one with rf and every WACC by 0.56-0.92pp per 1pp; a 4pp gap between quote and policy rate at a cycle top is a systematic upward bias on every Egyptian rate, compounded by C1 when held flat for ever. Common to all five names, so not a driver of the cross-sectional pattern; em_practitioner and calibration_statistician rate it a hygiene defect worth ~1pp of Ke (4-6% of value), not a cause of -28%/-60%.

causes.share_of_pessimism: Second-order and universal: 1pp of rf is ~4-6% of value on a 55-75% terminal-share DCF, so the 4pp quote-vs-policy wedge is worth ~10-20% of the DCF lens on every Egyptian name IF the policy rate is the better expectation and ~0 if the bond quote is. PHDC Kd weight effect +-0.64/sh on the central; a +-2pp Kd error is +-0.7pp WACC. Not a driver of the cross-sectional pattern.

causes.cause: EGCH's -73% is produced by its driver model alone: the 264kt ANNA ammonium-nitrate complex (EGP 14.7bn unspent) modelled at ~zero EBIT after depreciation at 50% utilisation / USD 280/t, an export urea path 530 -> 440 USD/t (-6.7%/yr real USD) frozen into the perpetuity, and statutory tax on a no-tax company — while the walk-forward beside it measured a 55-of-55-cell revenue under-forecast of -0.60 log (net -0.84, tax_current -1.30) that the correction rule refused to act on. No discount rate closes it (price-implied flat rate 7.9%; grid max 3.67/sh across USD 380-540 x 17-24%).
causes.layer: STATEMENT PROJECTION — driver specification on one name (a conclusion about a capital programme, possibly wrong, but not the house's valuation-layer lean)
causes.mechanism: The gap is a judgement about the expansion's economics, so cost-of-capital, terminal and lens corrections close at most ~11% of it (terminal ERP normalisation +0.4-0.9, statutory tax +0.44-0.97, CDS basis +0.3-0.7/sh). The walk-forward's own record says the method misses this company's expansions, which is the only evidential lever against the conclusion. valuation_theorist and em_practitioner classify EGCH as NOT a cause — a legitimate contrarian conclusion that must not be swept into the pessimism diagnosis; calibration_statistician claims it as a driver-specification instance while agreeing it is not a rate problem.
